summary: Barrage is a tense, tightly interlocking euro about hydroelectric dam building where every action you take denies a resource, a build slot, or a turn-order position to someone else. It rewards long-term engine planning but punishes players who can't adapt when their planned spot on the river or in the turn order gets taken first.
praised: Deep, tightly interlocking systems where resource, turn order, and board position all pressure each other
Strong player interaction through direct competition for limited spaces and resources, unusual for a heavy euro
High replayability from variable player powers, contracts, and modular board setup
Satisfying long-term engine building and combo potential
criticised: Very high complexity and rules overhead, steep learning curve for new players
Analysis paralysis and long turns, especially with four players
Turn order mechanism can feel punishing if you're consistently going last
Thin theme layered over a dense mechanical engine

interaction.kind: blocking and area denial over resources, build spots, and turn order

scoring.why: Winning comes from combining power production, contract fulfillment, building bonuses, and end-game objectives rather than any single dominant strategy
